title: CreditSights Head of Strategy on Bond Market Volatility
text: Winnie Cisar, Global Head of Strategy at CreditSights, discusses the strain from heavy corporate borrowing, including debt tied to AI infrastructure. She said individual issuer problems such as CoreWeave’s may coexist with a broader surge in issuance that is challenging investors’ ability to absorb new debt. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
